sources.entry: AppleAi - Access multiple AI assistants from your menu bar with one shortcut. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/bunnysayzz/AppleAI)

summary.one_liner: AppleAI is an archived, discontinued macOS menu bar app that opens ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI assistants in a compact chat window toggled with ⌘E.
keywords: access chatgpt from mac menu bar
summary.what_it_does: The README says the AppleAI app is discontinued and archived, and that its features now live in a separate app called Utilix. The archived app is a macOS menu bar app that opens each AI service's official website inside a WKWebView, with a compact always-on-top chat window. Users can switch between services such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral, Gemini and others, and toggle which ones appear in the menu. The window is toggled globally with ⌘E. Sessions persist per assistant across restarts, and the README lists light/dark themes, pinning, and an Open at Login option. The README says preferences and data are stored locally and that no auto-updater is included. Users should treat the repo as a historical archive rather than a maintained project.
use_cases: access several AI chatbots from the macOS menu bar
keep a floating AI chat window above other apps
quickly toggle an AI assistant with a global shortcut
run ChatGPT or Claude in a separate compact window on a Mac
reference older AI chat sessions per service
how_to_run: Download the last DMG Apple_AI_Universal.dmg from the repo's Releases page
Open the DMG and drag Apple AI to Applications
Launch Apple AI; a star icon appears in the macOS menu bar
If Gatekeeper blocks it, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway
Press ⌘E to toggle the chat window
notable: Opens each AI service's official website in a WKWebView rather than using APIs
Global ⌘E shortcut toggles a compact always-on-top window
Local-only storage of preferences and chats, per the README
Repo is archived; features moved to Utilix
caveats: Discontinued: no new versions will ship, and issues are closed in favor of Utilix
The README notes a Gatekeeper warning on install, requiring manual approval in System Settings
